stage01_deduplication.sdg_tags: union of the SDG tags of merged records

stage01a_consolidation.sdg2_assignment: SDG 2 exports of 7 October 2026 (query AND ORIG-LOAD-DATE BEF 20260509)
matching: fuzzy title (records without DOI; Stage 01 threshold and year window)

stage02_affiliations.country_attribution: direct, from the Scopus affiliation text (code/utils/country_normalisation.py); ROR is not used for countries
stage02_affiliations.ror_subset: data/external/ror/ror_africa_v2.json (organisations with a location in an AU member state)

stage04_indicators.country_counting: full counting by AU country unless stated otherwise

stage06_alignment.sdg_fractionalisation: 1/k per tagged SDG (k unique valid SDG tags of the record)
stage06_alignment.primary_country_counting: fractional: 1/(k*m), m = unique AU countries in au_countries (direct affiliation-text attribution, Stage 02)
stage06_alignment.sensitivity_country_counting: full: 1/k to every involved AU country
stage06_alignment.research_share: country SDG weight / country total over all 17 SDGs; true zeros retained
stage06_alignment.implementation_deficit: 100 - SDR 2025 goal score ('SDR2025 Data', 'Goal n Score'); no imputation
stage06_alignment.rho: scipy.stats.spearmanr (average ranks for ties); p-value reported, not used for inference
stage06_alignment.bootstrap_unit: country's paired (research share, deficit) SDG observations, resampled n with replacement
stage06_alignment.bootstrap_invalid: replicates with constant resampled research or deficit vector have undefined rho; counted, excluded from percentiles, never replaced
stage06_alignment.bootstrap_ci: 2.5/97.5 percentiles (numpy linear) of valid replicate rhos
stage06_alignment.quadrant_primary: SDG-specific medians among primary-eligible countries with a deficit for that SDG; 'high' = value >= median
stage06_alignment.threshold_sensitive_flag: SDG flagged threshold-sensitive when the LH count range across the three schemes exceeds 25% of countries with data for that SDG

stage08_networks.country_source: utils/country_normalisation.py on raw Affiliations (identical implementation to Stage 02)
stage08_networks.africa_definition: African Union member states (AU-54, country_lists/au54_countries.csv); other African territories count as non-AU
stage08_networks.full_pair_counting: each unordered pair of distinct countries on a record = 1
stage08_networks.fractional_pair_counting: each of the p pairs on a record = 1/p (record total 1)
stage08_networks.keyword_geo_filter: 67 terms parsed from code/05a_thematic_map_F6.R (Stage 05 validated list), case-insensitive exact term
stage08_networks.keyword_edges_stored_for: keywords with >= 2 document occurrences (pairs involving single-occurrence keywords cannot appear at any threshold >= 2; their count is reported)
stage08_networks.institution_source: ror_ids (Stage 02; African ROR subset; country-consistent, ambiguity-safe; fuzzy matches gated by institutional core)
